title: Aromatic Egyptian Beef Kebabs
description: A winey, cheese-pull, brunch-mood Egyptian dish featuring lean minced beef, char-grill-yang, and Jain-friendly ingredients, served in a hot-pot vessel.
instructions: Preheat a char-grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the minced beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well.
Thread the beef mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small saucepan, heat the red wine over low heat until warm.
Serve the beef kebabs in a hot-pot vessel with the warm red wine and shredded cheddar cheese.
Let each guest assemble their own kebabs by dipping the beef into the wine and then the cheese.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
